text:
gina (PM): quick sync — we need a decision on the Small Business pack shape before i hand to sales

samir (Sales): yes please. customer asks coming in for a cheap committed tier + a ‘surge’ bucket and optional priority routing. what should the min commit look like? :thinking:

anika (Eng): from infra side burst credits are fine, but priority-routing implies perf SLAs and preferential capacity. we need fallback behavior defined.

marta (Finance): margin target is >55% gross on hosted api for this segment. burst causes variability — need pricing buffer or usage throttles.

lenny (Legal): contract concerns: burst credits = credits not cash; expiry and refund rules must be explicit. also must avoid language that guarantees availability beyond our SLA tiers.

samir (Sales): proposing: $499/mo baseline, 100k burst tokens included, 20% uplift for priority-routing add-on. min commit either 1 or 3 months? customers pushing for 1 but enterprise wants 6.

gina (PM): throwing an initial config for discussion:

```
# proposed pack config (draft)
tier: small-business
price_monthly: $499
burst_credits: 100000 tokens (30d expiry)
add_ons:
  - priority-routing: +20% price (soft SLA: 95pct p99 latency)
  - dedicated-gpu: +$2000/mo (reserved capacity)
constraints:
  min_commit_months: 3
  max_burst_throttle: automatic at 200% baseline qps
```

anika (Eng): looks reasonable. need to add: fallback path to lower model variant when capacity spike, and autoscale budget limits. also quantify expected qps per customer for 100k tokens.

marta (Finance): can we model unit economics for 3mo commit vs 1mo? if we go 1mo we need a higher uplift or lower included burst.

samir (Sales): 3mo will block some self-serve buyers. can we pilot 3mo for sales-assisted leads and 1mo for self-serve with different burst sizes?

lenny (Legal): separate playbook for cancellations during pilot. also clause: unused burst expires, non-refundable. exceptions handled by CSM for fraud/abuse.

gina (PM): launch gating checklist suggestion:
- Pilot with 10 customers (mix self-serve + sales-assisted)
- Billing & metering integration for burst tracking
- Docs + UI to show remaining burst (self-serve)
- Legal contract clause drafted
- Finance confirms margin model for each variant
- Eng runbook for fallback + performance guardrails

ops-bot: deployment note — capacity planner has a 2w lead time for reserved slots, autoscale tested in staging.

anika (Eng): for rollout we should feature-flag priority-routing and add throttles that are observable. required metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency, throttled_requests, burst_consumed_tokens.

marta (Finance): target: 60% of pilot customers convert to paid commit at ≥3mo to consider GA. otherwise iterate.

samir (Sales): action: i'll target two inbound SMB customers this week for pilot interest.

gina (PM): action items:
- gina: draft pilot package + product page copy
- lenny: contract language for burst expiry & refund exceptions
- marta: margin sensitivity for 1/3/6 mo commits
- anika: infra checklist + fallback implementation estimate
- samir: list of pilot candidates

marta (Finance): +1 on timeline — can we run a price sensitivity quick calc by EOD Thu?

lenny (Legal): will draft a short addendum and ping gina for review by Fri.

gina (PM): ok, i’ll assemble the pilot doc and drop in this channel when ready. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
